title: 21 Machines That Turn Your Garage Into a Business
promo_conflict: Host links to where each machine can be bought (L0002), probably affiliate links, which rewards listing many machines. Nearly every revenue claim is second-hand or hypothetical.

idea.name: Recycled-bottle cheese boards
idea.one_liner: Melt empty wine bottles flat in a kiln, add a logo, and sell them back to wineries and breweries for their gift shops, or sell on Etsy.
idea.offer: Logo-branded cheese boards made from slumped glass bottles
idea.revenue_model: Sale per unit to venues or consumers

key_quotes.quote: take their empty bottles, melt it down, put their logo on it, and sell it back to them
Endless possibilities of things that you can do with glass bottles, and your raw materials are 100% free.

claims.quote: This is that same wine bottle, but it's a cheese board that sells for 30 to 80 bucks.
Entry-level kilns like this one start just over a thousand dollars.
Machine number one is the one that turns a piece of trash into a $50 product.

acquisition_channels.details: Suggested: go round wineries and breweries in person

ideas.delivery: Founder collects bottles, slumps them in the kiln, adds logos and delivers the boards
ideas.other_uk_rules: Glass that touches food must meet UK food contact materials rules. Using a winery's logo needs a licence or permission.

idea.name: Custom neon signs
idea.one_liner: Make custom neon signs for bars, gyms, salons and weddings and sell each one.
idea.customer: Bars, gyms, salons, clubs, couples, party hosts
idea.offer: Custom neon signs with names or logos

key_quotes.quote: Bars, gyms, salons, weddings, bridal showers, all potential customers that can have custom signs.

claims.quote: These cost around two grand for an entry-level one and can make custom neon signs.
And these signs sell anywhere from 80 to 400 plus dollars.

acquisition_channels.details: Not stated; customer types listed only

ideas.delivery: Founder makes the signs in a garage and ships or delivers them
ideas.other_uk_rules: Electrical products must meet the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 and carry UKCA marking.

idea.name: Edible image cake printing
idea.one_liner: Print custom images onto cakes and cupcakes, either as a service for bakeries or direct to consumers.
idea.revenue_model: Charge per cake or per print

key_quotes.quote: Either you can go to a bakery and offer your services there, or you can go directly to the consumer.

claims.quote: This machine costs under a thousand dollars, 580 to 750.

acquisition_channels.details: Sell direct to consumers; channel not stated

ideas.delivery: Founder prints the edible images and makes or decorates the cakes
ideas.other_uk_rules: Must register as a food business with the council and get a food hygiene rating. Allergen labelling and food additive rules apply to the edible inks.

stated_problem.quote: They're always looking for things to upsell.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: 3D laser glass engraving
idea.one_liner: Engrave photos, logos and names inside glass, sold as memorial upsells through pet cremation and funeral services.
idea.customer: Pet cremation and funeral services, and their clients
idea.offer: Glass blocks engraved with a pet or loved one
idea.revenue_model: Sale per piece, wholesale through partners

key_quotes.quote: maybe a picture of their pet inside a piece of glass, or a picture of their loved one inside a piece of glass.

claims.quote: This one starts at $2,800 and it burns a picture or a logo on glass.

acquisition_channels.details: Supply pet cremation and funeral services as an upsell

ideas.delivery: Founder engraves the glass and supplies it through partners
ideas.other_uk_rules: Customer photos are personal data under UK GDPR. Laser equipment safety (Class 4 lasers) applies.

stated_problem.quote: Every taqueria, every place that uses tortillas, most of them are buying them off a truck that comes a couple times a week.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Fresh tortilla wholesale route
idea.one_liner: Make fresh tortillas and supply a recurring delivery route of taquerias.
idea.customer: Taquerias and restaurants that use tortillas

key_quotes.quote: If you can get a route of taquerias or places that use tortillas built up, they are recurring customers.

claims.quote: And this tortilla machine that I found here costs $750 for one of the smaller ones.
they all go all the way up to three to five thousand dollars for a big one

acquisition_channels.details: Build a route of local taquerias

ideas.delivery: Founder makes the tortillas and delivers them several times a week
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration, HACCP and allergen labelling. Usually a commercial kitchen rather than a garage. Few taquerias in the UK.

idea.name: CNC custom wood products
idea.one_liner: Cut and engrave custom wood products such as boards, coasters, cabinets and cornhole sets on a CNC router.

key_quotes.quote: you can make things like custom cabinets, charcuterie boards, cheese boards, coasters, cornhole sets.

claims.quote: This one costs three grand and it can custom cut and engrave wood.

ideas.delivery: Founder cuts, finishes and ships the products
ideas.other_uk_rules: Boards that touch food must meet food contact rules. Wood dust exposure falls under COSHH.

idea.name: Wholesale coffee roasting
idea.one_liner: Roast green coffee beans and sell them wholesale to cafes on weekly reorders.
idea.revenue_model: Recurring wholesale orders and retail bags

key_quotes.quote: One wholesale cafe that you can get as an account can beat selling hundreds of bags at the farmers market.

claims.quote: Now, this one that I found is $2,500.
They can go anywhere from two to 15 grand for a coffee roasting machine.
Regular green coffee beans reportedly run three to five dollars a pound.

claims.claim: Roasted beans sell for $16-24 per lb
claims.quote: Roasted, they can be 16 to 24 dollars a pound.
They are recurring and they're going through beans quickly. They reorder every single week.

acquisition_channels.details: Sign up wholesale cafe accounts and sell at farmers markets

ideas.delivery: Founder roasts, packs and delivers the beans
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration. Roasting smoke may need local authority environmental permission.

idea.name: UV-printed custom press-on nails
idea.one_liner: Print customer-supplied images onto press-on nails and post them, for hen parties, salons and small brands.
idea.customer: Hen parties, salons, small brands, consumers

key_quotes.quote: These are perfect for bachelorette parties, salons, at the mall, small brands on people's fingernails, their brands.
You can print all the nails off that they can stick on and then send them to them.

claims.quote: This machine costs about $1,700 that I found.

acquisition_channels.details: Customers send in images; channel not stated

ideas.delivery: Founder prints the nails at home and posts them
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK Cosmetics Regulation may apply to the nail adhesives. Brand logos raise IP permission issues.

stated_problem.quote: Most bubble tea shops are using frozen boba tea that is imported.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Fresh boba pearl supply
idea.one_liner: Make fresh boba pearls locally and sell them on recurring orders to bubble tea shops.

key_quotes.quote: Fresh ones are better tasting, better for you, and shops are willing to buy those over the imported ones.
And these are shops that are constantly ordering boba on a recurring basis.

claims.quote: This one here I found costs about $1,300.

ideas.delivery: Founder makes the pearls and delivers them
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration and HACCP. Fresh boba has a short shelf life.

stated_problem.quote: She has a beautiful bouquet and then 4 days later it dies.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Wedding flower freeze-dry preservation
idea.one_liner: Freeze-dry wedding bouquets and set them in resin or keepsake boxes, with customers referred by local flower shops.
idea.customer: Brides and others marking special occasions, via florists

key_quotes.quote: a lot of flower shops would love to upsell a service but they don't have this machine and they don't offer that service.
a great way to get customers with a simple just B2B contract at local flower shops.

claims.quote: the customer hands you the raw product and you hand it back and they pay you $500.
So this one costs about $1,900.
So bride spends thousands of dollars on flowers for her wedding.

ideas.delivery: Founder receives the flowers, freeze-dries them, sets them in resin or boxes, and returns them
ideas.other_uk_rules: Resin handling falls under COSHH. Consumer Contracts Regulations apply to bespoke orders.

stated_problem.quote: There is a huge demand for protein bars for just real ingredients in protein bars and like granola style bars.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Real-ingredient protein bars
idea.one_liner: Make protein and granola bars from real ingredients and sell them at farmers markets and local grocers.
idea.customer: Farmers market shoppers, small local grocers
idea.revenue_model: Retail and wholesale sale per unit

key_quotes.quote: This is a great thing to sell at farmers markets, you know, even small local grocers in your town to get started.

claims.quote: Costs about $12,000 for this one.
They can go anywhere from 4 to like 15 grand.

ideas.delivery: Founder produces, packs and sells the bars
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration, nutrition and allergen labelling, and must follow the rules on nutrition and health claims such as 'protein'.

idea.name: Clicker-press custom goods
idea.one_liner: Die-cut leather, foam and vinyl into customisable wallets, coasters, key fobs and similar items.

key_quotes.quote: So, you can make all sorts of things like wallets, belts, key fobs, phone cases, coasters, sandals.

ideas.delivery: Founder cuts and assembles the products

idea.name: 3D-printed custom chocolates
idea.one_liner: 3D print chocolate in custom shapes and logos for customers who want unique pieces.

key_quotes.quote: There are a lot of people who would love to buy just a unique custom-shaped piece of chocolate.

claims.quote: This one cost about a thousand dollars and it 3D prints designs out of chocolate

ideas.delivery: Founder prints and packs the chocolates
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration and allergen labelling.

idea.name: Chocolate high heels (trade show seller)
idea.one_liner: A company seen at a trade show sold 3D-printed chocolate high heels and sold out fast.

key_quotes.quote: I went to a trade show one time and a company was doing this, selling chocolate high heels.

claims.quote: So, different designs of high heels and they sold out in like 10 minutes.

ideas.delivery: Company 3D prints the chocolates and sells them at the show
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration and allergen labelling.

idea.name: Custom bath bombs
idea.one_liner: Press custom bath bombs, such as ones with a prize inside or spa-branded designs, and sell them at farmers markets and to spas.
idea.revenue_model: Retail and wholesale sale per unit

key_quotes.quote: There are a lot of people in this space, but I think there's still opportunity.

claims.quote: This one I found this machine cost about $1,200.

ideas.delivery: Founder makes and supplies the bath bombs
ideas.other_uk_rules: Under the UK Cosmetics Regulation each product needs a Cosmetic Product Safety Report (CPSR), a named Responsible Person and SCPN notification. Toys inside fall under toy safety rules.

stated_problem.quote: Everyone wants to buy fresh, real food for their dog
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Single-ingredient dehydrated dog treats
idea.one_liner: Dehydrate single ingredients such as sweet potato and liver into dog treats, sold at markets, pet shops and groomers.
idea.customer: Dog owners, local pet shops, groomers
idea.revenue_model: Retail and wholesale sale per unit

key_quotes.quote: Single ingredient stuff like sweet potato, chicken, beef liver and sell it as real, whole, fresh ingredients for your dog

acquisition_channels.details: Farmers markets, local pet shops, groomers

ideas.delivery: Founder dehydrates, packs and supplies the treats
ideas.other_uk_rules: Pet food made from animal products needs APHA approval under the animal by-products rules, plus registration with the local authority and pet food labelling.

idea.name: Custom knitted beanies and scarves
idea.one_liner: Machine-knit branded beanies and scarves for breweries, wineries and restaurants to sell in their gift shops.

key_quotes.quote: Offer to make them custom scarves and custom knitted beanies that they can sell in their gift shops.

claims.quote: This one costs anywhere from four to seven grand.

acquisition_channels.details: Pitch local breweries, wineries and restaurants

ideas.delivery: Founder knits the items and delivers them
ideas.other_uk_rules: Textile fibre labelling rules apply.

idea.name: Tablet-press products
idea.one_liner: Press powders into niche tablet products such as toothpaste tablets, mints and dishwasher tabs.

key_quotes.quote: I would go after more things that are unique that not a lot of people are doing like toothpaste tablets, mints, dishwasher tabs.

ideas.delivery: Founder presses and packs the tablets
ideas.other_uk_rules: Toothpaste tablets fall under the UK Cosmetics Regulation (CPSR). Dishwasher tabs fall under the CLP and detergents regulations. Mints need food business registration. Anything medicinal is regulated by the MHRA.

idea.name: Custom-shaped branded gummies
idea.one_liner: Make jelly candies in custom shapes and sizes, including logo gummies for businesses.

key_quotes.quote: There's a lot of potential with just messing around with different ways to use jelly candies.

claims.quote: This machine costs around $3,000 that I found here.

ideas.delivery: Founder makes and packs the gummies
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration, allergen labelling and food additive rules.

idea.name: Gruens greens gummies
idea.one_liner: An existing brand (Gruens) sells gummies with athletic greens inside them.

key_quotes.quote: They started making gummies with basically athletic greens inside of them.

ideas.delivery: Brand manufactures and sells the gummies
ideas.other_uk_rules: Food supplements regulations, nutrition and health claims rules, and novel food checks apply.

idea.name: Supplement powder pouches
idea.one_liner: Fill pouches like nicotine pouches with energy, focus or electrolyte supplements instead of nicotine.

key_quotes.quote: there is a huge market now for different alternative versions of these kind of like nicotine pouches.

ideas.delivery: Founder fills and packs the pouches
ideas.other_uk_rules: Food supplements regulations, health claims rules and novel food checks apply. The Tobacco and Vapes Bill may restrict nicotine-style pouches.

idea.name: Local maple syrup
idea.one_liner: Boil sap into maple syrup with a cheap evaporator and sell it wholesale or locally.

key_quotes.quote: anywhere with maple trees, you can sell local fresh maple syrup just with this machine.

claims.quote: And I found one from Asia for 218 bucks that you can import.
Syrup wholesales for $50 to $70 a gallon.

ideas.delivery: Founder taps trees, boils the sap and bottles the syrup
ideas.other_uk_rules: Needs food business registration. The UK climate and lack of sugar maples make this largely unworkable.

idea.name: Organic pillows and bean bags (filling machine)
idea.one_liner: Blow organic cotton or insulation filling into pillows and bean bag shells and sell them; host says an acquaintance made $500k/yr this way.
idea.offer: Organic pillows, bean bag chairs, dog beds, comforters

key_quotes.quote: this guy was making most of his money, the guy I know who got this machine, selling organic pillows.
He would get the exterior zippered part of a bean bag, blow all the insulation inside, and sell them.

claims.claim: An acquaintance made $500k/year from one machine in a garage
claims.quote: a guy in my town bought this single machine and was making $500,000 a year
And he was making $500,000 a year.
This one runs $6,800, but there are endless opportunities to make different products with this.

ideas.delivery: Operator fills, closes and ships the products
ideas.other_uk_rules: Bean bags, pillows and filled furniture must meet the Furniture and Furnishings (Fire) (Safety) Regulations 1988. Bean bags also need child-safe zips. Organic claims need certification.
